frozen_protocol.selection: minimum original paid Phi; all native extra physical audits retained and charged
frozen_protocol.secondary: min original R among legal original-CN99 paid candidates, fallback primary
frozen_protocol.corrector: unchanged physical L-BFGS-B max3000/12000; same prior, complete paid state retention
frozen_protocol.cadence: first complete material update after each absolute two-process-CPU-second bucket; preserve native initial/stage/final audits. Corrector/direct every paid objective evaluation.
frozen_protocol.truth_policy: NONE online; seal BOTH independent campaigns before any fresh material truth score
frozen_protocol.scope: 48 independent material objects, eight hidden families, six acquisition/noise conditions; crossgrid is model-mismatch stress, not noise-qualified truth accuracy
frozen_protocol.parameter_policy: No fresh-result-dependent method changes, case exclusion, thresholds or budget extensions
